slipway.description: Primary orchestrator — routes the pipeline, enforces step order, never generates content directly

chartmaker.description: Raw prompt / partial PRD → complete .ai/docs/01-prd.md with P0/P1/P2 ranking

cartographer.description: Reverse-engineers existing codebase into .ai/docs/ with confidence markers

bosun.description: Cross-doc validation + per-doc health score 0–100 + severity-ranked findings

rigger.description: Phase/milestone breakdown → .ai/planning/ with S/M/L sizing, dependency graph, and P0/P1/P2 phase ordering

purser.description: Time and token cost forecast per phase based on .ai/planning/

coxswain.description: Multi-lens sprint grooming (Lead Dev, QA, DevOps, Complexity Audit) with cross-lens synthesis

shipwright.description: Update existing docs when a new feature is introduced — proactive ADR conflict pre-flight before scoping

chronicler.description: Post-implementation doc sync — detect and classify drift (DRIFT / INTENTIONAL / UNKNOWN)

surveyor.description: Post-implementation DB schema vs 04-data-models.md consistency check

gunner.description: Auth, secrets, attack surface audit — PASS / CONDITIONAL / BLOCK gate

quick.description: Trivial or pattern-matching tasks — fast and cheap

standard.description: Default for most generation and analysis tasks

deep.description: Reasoning-heavy tasks — validation, security audit, orchestration
